segments.text: You bookmark an article, come back to it later, and get a pop-up wall, autoplay video, and a payw wall where the content used to be. COD shadows it. It mirrors
any website for offline viewing with all the JavaScript stripped out. Clean, fast, permanent copies of pages you actually want to keep. Read on a plane.
Keep it after the original vanishes. Skip the modern web's noise entirely.
